title: May Flower
author: Bina Singh
text:
Was it the May Flower
In its spring bloom
Enchanting, inviting
It`s exotic aroma seeped in
The captivating fragrance caught me
And the intoxication was enthusing
It came suddenly
Caught me unprepared
The dormant desires were alive
Sleeping sensuality was awakened
It came like the lightening
The breaking West Wind
Crumbling, plundering my vulnerability
Before I realised, the miraculous magic imprisoned me
Although bewildered, yet I continued to suck its nectar
Sweet sensation lingered, soaking me in the passionate Deep
Sudden knocking
Pulled me out from the magical intoxication
I felt the cold fabric beneath
Wondering, was it a phantom of delight
Or
My sensuous dream
To Love and be loved
